newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU, Australia discuss farm trade issues.
newsitem.headline: EU, Australia discuss farm trade issues.

text.p: Australian foreign minister Alexander Downer discussed with EU Farm Commissioner Franz Fischler on Wednesday progress towards an accord on mutual recognition of veterinary standards.

A basic text has already been agreed but there's still some work to be done on technical annexes, said an Australian official before the meeting, noting that some A$400 million trade was potentially at risk.

Also on the agenda were the future of the EU's Common Agricultural Policy (CAP) in order to keep it within budget guidelines, World Trade Organisation free trade rules and catering for the EU's expansion eastwards.
Neither European Commission nor Australian farm officials were immediately available for comment.
